scope: Private bounded four-message AVX2 SHA-3/SHAKE/cSHAKE component and fixed-page resident
platforms: Native Linux x86_64 on AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D
Local Windows 11 x64 KVM guest; native-process MSVC tests, not VBS enclave execution
windows_checkout: Restored development checkout plus source-bound overlay, not a clean exact Git checkout

contract.output_slots: Four zero-padded 256-byte retained slots; exact identity and bit length bound on export
contract.route: Require actual four-state AVX2 dispatch; scalar tails counted explicitly; no portable fallback
contract.metadata: Lengths, identity, output shape and work budget are public
contract.placement: Owner and borrowed authority occupy disjoint aligned regions of one exclusively borrowed 4096-byte page; destroy borrower before authority, then clear the entire page

oracle: Separate Python Keccak/SP 800-185 implementation cross-checked against the NIST bit-vector file, cSHAKE examples and byte-aligned hashlib results; mixed identities/rates, empty messages/output, canonical partial bits, N/S and input/output bounds

placement_model.scope: Lifetime doubles exercise allocation provenance, disjoint placement, drop ordering, full-page clear and constructor rollback. No cryptography, OS protection or enclave execution.

artifact_validation: Source hashes match the working tree; generated sources/vectors and recorded native executables match their hashes; child component record is bound by the resident record. Preserved outside target/.
remaining: VBS worker wire protocol, bounded OS-copy transport and admission
Supported affine host API and mandatory production image policy
Independent review and production deployment qualification
